app_name.description: The working name of the site, shown in the header and the browser tab.

meta_description.message: A place to ask for prayer and to pray for others.
meta_description.description: Short description for search engines and link previews. Never contains request text.

skip_to_requests.description: Hidden link for keyboard and screen-reader users that jumps past the header.

tabs_label.description: Screen-reader name for the two tabs that choose the ordering.

tab_need.description: Tab: requests with the fewest prayers first. The default view.

tab_new.description: Tab: most recently published requests first.

kind_self.description: Card label: the author asks for prayer for themselves.

kind_other.description: Card label: the author asks for prayer for another person.

kind_event.description: Card label: the request is for an event or a group of people.

prayed_none.description: Shown on a card nobody has prayed for yet.

prayed_one.description: Prayer count on a card, plural form 'one'. Languages may also define prayed_zero, prayed_two, prayed_few, prayed_many.

prayed_other.description: Prayer count on a card, general plural form. {n} is the number.

more.description: Link at the bottom of the wall that loads the next 20 requests.

empty.message: There are no requests here yet.
empty.description: Shown when the wall has nothing to show.

language.description: Heading of the language list in the footer.

source_code.description: Footer link to the source code of the running version.
